# toml corpus

## Source

Real-world TOML files, copied unchanged: the `Cargo.toml.orig` of the published crates toml, toml_parser, toml_edit, toml_datetime and toml_writer (MIT OR Apache-2.0), and this repository's own manifests, each named by its prefix in `NOTICE`.

## Version

toml 1.1.4, toml_parser 1.1.3, toml_edit 0.23.10, toml_datetime 1.1.1 and toml_writer 1.1.2; the repository's own files at the commit that added them.
